title: Dave Mirra BMX Challenge (Nintendo Wii) | eBay
snippet: LOL :) Happy with the purchase!While I have not personally played the game, it has not come out of the Wii since I got it. It is the new favorite game! The graphics are good and the choices of bikes and characters are plenty. The big plus is that it is a FOUR player game!!! The kids are having a great time "running into the walls" and crashing to watch the different ways the characters fall! LOL :) Happy with the purchase! ... This game is fun. I enjoy bmx in real life, so I may be biased, but its fun to "pretend" to do these tricks and ride these spots.
